logicIndex.declaration: edAddRow(k, cs) { this.edPatch(dr => { const r = {}; COLSETS[cs].forEach(c => { r[c.k] = c.dv !== undefined ? c.dv : (c.t === 'check' ? false : ''); }); dr.b[k] = (dr.b[k] || []).concat([r]); }); }

logicIndex.name: edDelRow
logicIndex.declaration: edDelRow(k, ri) { this.edPatch(dr => { dr.b[k] = dr.b[k].filter((x, i) => i !== ri); }); }

logicIndex.name: goTask
logicIndex.declaration: goTask(id, tab) { this.guard(() => this.setState({nav:'wbs', sel:id, tab:tab || this.state.tab, back:[], full:false, gateOpen:false})); }

logicIndex.name: goExec
logicIndex.declaration: goExec(task, att) { this.guard(() => this.setState({nav:'exec', exSel:{task, att:att || null}, exForm:null})); }

logicIndex.name: goCp
logicIndex.declaration: goCp(id) { this.guard(() => this.setState({nav:'change', cpSel:id, cpComment:'', cpErr:''})); }

logicIndex.name: cpTargets
logicIndex.declaration: cpTargets(d, cp) { const out = []; cp.ops.forEach(o => [o.task, o.succ, o.pred].forEach(x => { if (x && d.tasks[x] && out.indexOf(x) < 0) out.push(x); })); return out; }

logicIndex.name: plSet
logicIndex.declaration: plSet(pid, rid, patch) { this.mutate(dd => dd.plannings.forEach(p => { if (p.id === pid) p.review.forEach(rv => { if (rv.id === rid) Object.assign(rv, patch); }); })); }

logicIndex.name: cpmRow
logicIndex.declaration: cpmRow(i, patch) { const m = this.state.cpm; this.cpmSet({rows:m.rows.map((r, j) => j === i ? Object.assign({}, r, patch) : r)}); }

logicIndex.name: exSet
logicIndex.declaration: exSet(patch) { const F = this.state.exForm; this.setState({exForm:Object.assign({}, F, {f:Object.assign({}, F.f, patch)})}); }

logicIndex.name: resetUsage
logicIndex.declaration: resetUsage(ag) { const now = nowStr(); this.mutate(dd => { dd.usage[ag] = {remain:100, reset:'', at:now}; Sel.driftCheck(dd, now, ag + ' 사용량 리셋'); }, [], ag + ' 사용량 리셋을 반영했습니다.'); }

logicIndex.name: setPolicy
logicIndex.declaration: setPolicy(patch, why) { const now = nowStr(); this.mutate(dd => { Object.assign(dd.sched.policy, patch); if (why) Sel.driftCheck(dd, now, why); }, [], '일정 정책을 저장했습니다.'); }

logicIndex.name: afterRun
logicIndex.declaration: afterRun(dd, now, trig, est) { if (est) { if (dd.sched.policy.autoReplan) Sel.replan(dd, now, trig, PA); else Sel.driftCheck(dd, now, trig); } }

logicIndex.name: openRunEdit
logicIndex.declaration: openRunEdit(id, role) { const r = this.state.data.tasks[id][RUN_ROLE[role].key]; this.setState({runEdit:{task:id, role, model:r.model, effort:r.effort}}); }

logicIndex.name: setRunPolicy
logicIndex.declaration: setRunPolicy(patch, msg) { this.mutate(dd => { Object.assign(dd.exec.policy, patch); }, [], msg); }

logicIndex.name: setEscNotify
logicIndex.declaration: setEscNotify(n) { this.mutate(dd => { dd.exec.policy.escNotify = n; }, [], n ? '최상위 등급에서 재작업 ' + n + '회째부터 팀장에게 알립니다.' : '최상위 등급 재작업 알림을 끕니다.'); }

logicIndex.name: delBlackout
logicIndex.declaration: delBlackout(dt) { const now = nowStr(); this.mutate(dd => { dd.sched.blackouts = dd.sched.blackouts.filter(x => x.date !== dt); Sel.driftCheck(dd, now, '작업 불가일 해제 (' + dt + ')'); }, [], dt + ' 작업 불가일을 해제했습니다.'); }

logicIndex.name: goVerif
logicIndex.declaration: goVerif(vid) { this.guard(() => this.setState({nav:'verify', vf:Object.assign({}, this.state.vf, {tab:'results', sel:vid, result:'', agent:''})})); }

logicIndex.name: tgDraft
logicIndex.declaration: tgDraft() { const C = this.state.data.tg.conf; return this.state.tgF || Object.assign(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(C)), {token:'', tokMode: C.tokenSet ? 'keep' : 'replace'}); }

logicIndex.name: tgDrain
logicIndex.declaration: tgDrain() { this.mutate(dd => { dd.tg.log.forEach(x => { if (x.st === '재시도 대기' && /^요청 제한/.test(x.err)) { x.st = '전송 요청 수락'; x.tries += 1; x.err = '요청 제한(429) → 15초 후 재시도 성공'; } }); }, [], null); }

logicIndex.name: tgCancel
logicIndex.declaration: tgCancel() { this.setState({tgF:null, notice:'변경을 취소했습니다 — 저장된 값으로 되돌렸습니다.'}); }

logicIndex.name: tgFresh
logicIndex.declaration: tgFresh() { this.mutate(dd => { dd.tg.conf = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(TG_BLANK)); }, [], 'Mock: Telegram 연결을 처음 설정 상태로 되돌렸습니다 (전송 이력은 유지).'); this.setState({tgF:null, tgSim:'ok'}); }

logicIndex.name: tgFindQuery
logicIndex.declaration: tgFindQuery() { const F = this.state.tgFind; this.setState({tgFind:Object.assign({}, F, {phase:'loading', pick:''})});

logicIndex.name: tgFindPick
logicIndex.declaration: tgFindPick() { const F = this.state.tgFind, c = F.cands.filter(x => x.id === F.pick)[0]; if (!c) return; this.tgEdit({chatId:c.id}); this.setState({tgF:Object.assign({}, this.tgDraft(), {chat:{name:c.name, type:c.type}}), tgFind:null, notice:c.name + ' 을(를) 수신 대상으로 넣었습니다 — 테스트 알림으로 확인 후 저장하세요.'}); }

logicIndex.name: tgRule
logicIndex.declaration: tgRule(k) { const R = Object.assign({}, this.state.tgR || this.state.data.tg.rules); R[k] = !R[k]; this.setState({tgR:R}); }

logicIndex.name: tgRuleSave
logicIndex.declaration: tgRuleSave() { const R = this.state.tgR; if (!R) return; this.mutate(dd => { dd.tg.rules = Object.assign({}, R); }, [], '알림 규칙을 저장했습니다.'); this.setState({tgR:null}); }

logicIndex.name: tgRuleCancel
logicIndex.declaration: tgRuleCancel() { this.setState({tgR:null, notice:'알림 규칙 변경을 취소했습니다.'}); }

logicIndex.name: tgGo
logicIndex.declaration: tgGo(nav) { if (!nav) return; if (nav.k === 'task') this.goTask(nav.id); else if (nav.k === 'cp') this.goCp(nav.id); else if (nav.k === 'ci') this.ciOpen(nav.id); else if (nav.k === 'settings') this.setState({nav:'settings', setTab:'runner'}); else if (nav.k === 'project') this.setState({nav:'project'}); else if (nav.k === 'design') this.dsOpen('dec'); }

logicIndex.name: appUrlSave
logicIndex.declaration: appUrlSave() { const v = (this.state.appUrlF == null ? this.state.data.appUrl : this.state.appUrlF).trim();

logicIndex.name: wset
logicIndex.declaration: wset(patch) { const w = this.state.wiz; this.setState({wiz:Object.assign({}, w, {d:Object.assign({}, w.d, patch)})}); }

logicIndex.name: wizErrs
logicIndex.declaration: wizErrs(wd) { return {title:!wd.title.trim(), type:!wd.type, domain:!wd.domain, purpose:!wd.purpose.trim(), doneCond:!wd.doneCond.trim(), est: !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(String(wd.est).trim()) || +wd.est <= 0 || +wd.est > 400, fixStart: !!String(wd.fixStart).trim() && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(wd.fixStart).trim())}; }

logicIndex.name: loadFlags
logicIndex.declaration: loadFlags(bar) { const dim = this._dimUntil > Date.now(); return {bar:{show:!!bar}, mainCls: dim ? 'main dim' : 'main', dim:{show:dim, l:'일정 다시 계산 중 — 잠시 후 갱신됩니다'}}; }
